USD Reserve and USD Cash Updates

 

As part of its capital framework, Strategy maintains: (i) a U.S. dollar reserve (the "USD Reserve"), which is intended to support the payment of dividends on Strategy's preferred stock and interest on its outstanding indebtedness, and (ii) "USD Cash", which management maintains to deploy for broader general Bitcoin Treasury Company purposes, which may include acquiring bitcoin, expanding the USD Reserve, broader capital management uses, and other similar purposes.

 

During the period from November 9, 2026 to November 15, 2026, Strategy used $18.9 million of the USD Reserve to fund the payment of dividends on its preferred stock.

 

As of November 15, 2026, the balances of the USD Reserve and USD Cash were $4.75 billion and $151.2 million, respectively.

 

Dividend Rate on Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock

 

On November 15, 2026, the Company announced that it will maintain the regular dividend rate per annum on STRC Stock for dividends with record dates from December 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 at 12.00%. The Company announced this rate via its website, www.strategy.com/strc. Such rate shall have no effect on any previously declared but unpaid dividends on STRC Stock. As previously announced, management will recommend to the board of directors that the Company maintain STRC Stock's regular dividend rate per annum at 12.00% until STRC Stock has demonstrated sustained, healthy trading near $100 per share.

Expected Tax Treatment

 

As of November 16, 2026, the Company expects that the December Daily Dividends and the quarterly dividends on STRF Stock, STRE Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock payable on December 31, 2026 will be characterized as non-taxable returns of capital to the extent of a shareholder's tax basis in their applicable preferred stock for U.S. federal income tax purposes. Special tax considerations may apply to certain taxpayers based on their specific circumstances. Shareholders should consult their own tax advisors regarding the U.S. federal, state, local, and any non-U.S. tax consequences to them in connection with the receipt of distributions.

 

Dividend Entitlement and Trading Mechanics

 

STRC Stock has, and effective January 1, 2027, STRF Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock will have, a dividend record date on every calendar day, including weekends and market and bank holidays.

 

However, for any shares cleared through The Depository Trust Company ("DTC"), a record date that falls on a weekend or other DTC holiday will be deemed by DTC to fall on the immediately preceding day that is not a DTC holiday.

 

Nasdaq generally sets the ex-dividend date on the record date or, if the record date is not a trading day, the immediately preceding trading day. As a result, if multiple daily dividends have record dates that fall on consecutive days that are DTC holidays, then they will be deemed by DTC to share a single record date occurring on the last preceding day that is not a DTC holiday, and by Nasdaq to share a single ex-dividend date occurring on the last preceding day that is a trading day, and will be paid together on the same payment date.

 

For example, the dividends with record dates of Friday, December 4 through Sunday, December 6, 2026 will each have a record date and ex-dividend date of December 4 for these purposes and will be paid on Monday, December 7; given the T+1 settlement cycle, the Company expects that an investor who executes a buy order on December 4 will receive none of these dividends and an investor who executes a sale order on December 4 will receive all three.

 

Dividend entitlement may differ for shares that are not cleared through DTC or that are traded on venues other than Nasdaq that offer weekend or market holiday trading. Those differences will depend on the trading, clearing and settlement arrangements of the relevant clearing platform or venue. In addition, individual brokers may have policies and procedures that result in a different treatment than that described above. Investors should consult their brokers.

 

Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.

 

Strategy Dashboard

 

Strategy also maintains a dashboard on its website (www.strategy.com) as a disclosure channel for providing broad, non-exclusionary distribution of information regarding Strategy to the public, including information regarding market prices of its outstanding securities, bitcoin purchases and holdings, certain key performance indicator metrics and other supplemental information, and as one means of disclosing non-public information in compliance with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Investors and others are encouraged to regularly review the information that Strategy makes public via the website dashboard.
